description: Bedsole Produce is an on-farm market in 2973 S County Road 49, AL, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
